notes: Show Mode: the in-person desk on one page. Tap or search a card and see your side (owned, paid, from, when) and the market with its proof; Sell into a bag, Buy what the customer brought, Trade across the table while you keep tapping; the customer screen follows. Show Mode takes Live Claims' place in the sidebar (Live Claims stays reachable one release from a link under the title). Orders: a Profit column per order, a total for the rows on screen, and a By show view. Price all leaves alone any card priced in the last hour.
